text:
rachel: Quick heads-up — I converted one of our TypeScript sample apps to a custom rollup+esbuild pipeline to match a partner build and hit a strange edge-only bug: auth retries end up concatenating the Authorization header. Node dev + SSR are fine.

yun: oh no. build or runtime?

rachel: runtime on Cloudflare Pages. First request returns 401 as expected with the bad key; retry shows header repeated: 
```
[redwood] auth failed (401)
Request headers: Authorization: Bearer BAD_KEY
Retrying...
Request headers: Authorization: Bearer BAD_KEY, Authorization: Bearer BAD_KEY
```

paul: we saw that pattern before. Usually caused by reusing a Headers instance when constructing the retry Request. Which import form? named/default?

rachel: import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference' (ESM). If I switch to require('@redwood/inference/dist/cjs') it doesn't reproduce.

yun: so packaging + bundler transform both suspect. Do you have a tiny repro and steps?

rachel: yes — committed a tiny repo (branch rollup-minify-edge). Steps: clone, npm ci, REDWOOD_API_KEY=bad npm run build:edge && npm run preview:edge, then curl the /api/llm route. Handler is two lines: 
```ts
import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference';
const c = createClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
export async function post(){ return new Response(await (await c.generate({prompt:'x'})).text()) }
```

annie: quick check: did you try changing retry code to clone headers via new Headers(orig.headers) before making the new Request? That fixed a different bundler case.

rachel: yes — I patched locally to: 
```js
const headers = new Headers(origReq.headers || {});
headers.set('Authorization', `Bearer ${apiKey}`);
const retry = new Request(origReq, { headers });
```
That removed duplication under miniflare/cloudflare preview. But I want a permanent fix.

paul: sounds like we should defensively clone headers in the SDK retry logic and add a small CI matrix that builds with rollup+terser, vite, and webpack and runs under worker shims. Also we need to fix typings: TS server misses overloads for ESM entry in some bundlers.

yun: yep — types issue likely from package.json exports not pointing "types" to the ESM path. Some TS consumers resolve types differently depending on bundler.

ci-bot: queued job devex/bundler-edge-auth-minify-repro (#78) — matrix: cloudflare/workers-v8, vercel-edge, wrangler-miniflare.

annie: action items: paul open PR to clone headers defensively + add unit/e2e matrix; yun update exports to ensure types for the ESM entry; rachel add repro README with exact rollup + terser config and note about default import sometimes masking the issue.

rachel: one last oddity — when I enable terser (mangle=true) the duplication becomes intermittent. That suggests minification changes closure ordering and exposes shared-state bug in transformed helper. I'll include that in the repro notes.
